answer.label: system-prompted
answer.justification: The layer-2 spike of 61.9 sits in the system-prompted range (31.7 – 64.0), while quantized and fine-tuned models stay under 6.1. Onset layer 8 matches system-prompted (7 – 8). Relative L2 climbs steeply to 0.479 at layer 16 and plateaus at 0.503 at layer 32, which matches that category's plateau. Final-layer cosine 0.847 is at the edge of its range (0.848 – 0.900). Effective rank 2.81 and direction consistency 0.538 also fit. The final-layer jump of +0.036 fits too. Layer 1 (0.146) and the mid-layer size ratio (0.971) are slightly outside the documented ranges but still closest to system-prompted. Fine-tuned is ruled out by the huge layer-2 spike and the low direction consistency. Quantized is ruled out by the large mid-layer differences and the low cosine.
